observations: The ordinary operation-name filters do not select every normalization graph in the authoritative factory.
test_norm_scale overrides op_desc with NORM_SCALE or RMS_NORM_SCALE and evaluates the whole norm-to-scale graph. The epsilon/width loops provide ten cases of each label.

The factory separately labels NORM_MUL_ADD, RMS_NORM_MUL_ADD and ADD_RMS_NORM. These include broadcasting, multi-add, residual/input aliasing, post-multiply, large-width and mixed F32/BF16 weight/residual configurations.
RMS normalization is also composed with RoPE and SET_ROWS in test_rms_norm_mul_rope; supporting ordinary RMS normalization does not establish those graphs.
